name: writing
description: Publication-prep tools for academic and public-facing writing. Five skills: style (17 canonical English-prose rules, 20 page-cap additions, 2 audit-time rules), preflight (deterministic pre-submission checks on a LaTeX tree), and the three figure skills plot, concept, and tikz, sharing one design system under figures/ (Google palette, venue-matched fonts, and the ten-rule DOCTRINE.md). The integrity-forensics suite moved to the separate anti-autoresearch plugin in 2.0.0.
